name: Gilgamesh
bible: A tall, lean, regal golden king with a proud straight back and chin lifted high. A NEAT, refined, handsome face: smooth fair skin, sharp elegant jaw, thin straight brows, slim almond CRIMSON eyes with a cool superior gaze, a composed smirk. SHORT golden-blond hair swept UP and BACK in sharp, stiff spikes. Full armour of polished GOLD plate: layered pauldrons, a cuirass with sunburst filigree and RUBY studs, gold gauntlets, a black fitted undersuit at the elbows and neck, gold greaves. A long CRIMSON silk waist drape hangs from a gold fauld to the shins. No cape. A slim gold torc at the throat. NO WEAPON: his HANDS ARE EMPTY and he commands. Small round GOLDEN RIFT PORTALS, gold rings the size of his head with a bright gold rim and a deep amber core, open in the air behind and above him; his treasures shoot point-first out of them: ornate GOLD swords and SILVER swords, gold spears, silver axes, gold halberds, up to NINE portals at once. Regal gestures direct them: an arm sweep, an open palm, a pointing finger, a finger snap. Energy: molten GOLD light with a white-hot core, SILVER glints, golden rift rings and sparks.
design:
- top row, first: full-body proud stance facing right, hands EMPTY, one hand on the hip, chin lifted, one small gold portal ring hovering behind his right shoulder with a gold sword hilt in it
- top row, second: a three-quarter close-up of the head, short golden hair swept up and back in spikes, a neat refined face and crimson almond eyes
- top row, third: a close view of three treasures (a gold sword, a silver sword, a gold spear) emerging point-first from one gold portal ring
- second row: a sweeping arm gesture firing a gold sword out of a portal; a pointing gesture firing a silver spear; a walking pose with the crimson drape swinging; a jump with the drape flaring
- third row: the charged volley with nine portals in an arc behind him; a plunge with blades firing downward; a guard with a gold shield half-emerging from a portal in front of him; a low crouch
- bottom row: a hit reaction; lying flat on the ground after the final blow; a victory pose with a crown of portals and circling gold and silver blades; the Vault of Ages, a storm of gold and silver treasures streaming out of golden portals

idle.title: Stance, guard, crouch and footwork
frames: combat loop 1: proud stance, weight on the back leg, LEFT hand on the hip, RIGHT hand relaxed and half-open at his side, one small gold portal ring hovering just behind his right shoulder with a gold sword hilt inside it, chin lifted
combat loop 2: the same stance breathing in, chest lifted, the same small gold portal ring behind the right shoulder, its glow pulsing slightly
combat loop 3: the same stance at the top of the breath, the same small gold portal ring behind the right shoulder
combat loop 4: the same stance breathing out, settling back toward combat loop 1, the same small gold portal ring behind the right shoulder
standing guard: left forearm raised palm-out, a golden portal opening in front of him with a gold shield's face half emerging to block, the right hand open at his side, braced, chin lifted
crouch: low crouch, right hand near the ground, weight low on bent knees, the shoulder portal still behind him
skid: braking hard from a run, hands empty, front foot planted forward, body leaning back, the crimson waist drape swinging forward
landing: a deep knee bend absorbing a landing from a jump, one hand low, hands otherwise empty, the crimson waist drape still settling

run.title: Regal run cycle (8 frames, loops from frame 8 back to frame 1)
frames: run cycle 1: right foot contact, stride long, body leaning forward, arms swinging, hands empty, the small gold portal ring trailing just behind his shoulder
run cycle 2: right foot down, body at its lowest, hands empty, the crimson waist drape streaming back
run cycle 3: passing pose, left knee driving forward, body rising, hands empty
run cycle 4: left leg reaching forward, body at its highest, both feet briefly off the ground, hands empty
run cycle 5: left foot contact, stride long (the mirror of run cycle 1), arms swinging, hands empty
run cycle 6: left foot down, body at its lowest, hands empty, the crimson waist drape streaming back
run cycle 7: passing pose, right knee driving forward, body rising, hands empty
run cycle 8: right leg reaching forward, body at its highest, both feet off the ground, hands empty

air.title: Jumping, falling, walls and ledges
frames: jump take-off: crouched spring an instant before leaving the ground, hands empty, the crimson waist drape lifting
rising: leaping upward, legs tucked under, hands empty, the crimson waist drape trailing down and gold sparks flaring
apex: at the top of the jump, knees tucked, body compact, the crimson waist drape billowing, gold sparks around him
falling: descending, legs extending to land, hands empty, the crimson waist drape and gold sparks flowing upward
fast fall: diving straight down, body straight and streamlined, hands empty, the crimson waist drape streaming up, gold sparks trailing
wall slide: back and left shoulder pressed against a wall on the LEFT, one hand bracing on it, the other hand empty, sliding down, one foot scraping the wall
ledge hang: hanging by both empty hands from a ledge edge above the head, body dangling below, legs together
ledge climb: pulling up over the ledge with empty hands, one knee up, chest over the edge

hurt.title: Getting hit, falling down and getting up
frames: light hit: flinching back from a blow, head snapped back, eyes squeezed, hands empty
light hit recovery: catching the balance, hands empty, guard coming back up, the small gold portal ring reappearing behind his shoulder
heavy hit: body bent backward by a heavy blow, arms flung out, hands empty, pain on the face
launched: flung off the feet and flying backward through the air, hands empty, the crimson waist drape streaming
fall: falling onto his back, about to hit the ground, hands empty
down: lying flat on his back on the ground, hands empty, the crimson waist drape spread out, the gold portal ring gone
getting up: pushing up onto one knee, hands empty, chin lifted
back on guard: rising back into the proud stance, hand on the hip, the shoulder portal reappearing behind him

atk-a.title: Basic combo strikes 1 and 2: golden portal shots (3 frames each)
frames: combo strike 1, anticipation: his right arm sweeps up and back, palm open, a small gold portal opening in the air behind his shoulder with a GOLD sword point emerging
combo strike 1, strike: he points forward with two fingers and the gold sword shoots straight out of the portal, a straight molten-gold streak kept inside this cell
combo strike 1, recovery: the hand lowered with disdain, the portal closing into sparks, the chin lifted
combo strike 2, anticipation: his left hand raised overhead, a portal above his head with a SILVER spear point emerging
combo strike 2, strike: a finger snap toward the front, the silver spear shoots forward and slightly down, a silver-gold streak kept inside this cell
combo strike 2, recovery: hand back on the hip, chin lifted, the crimson waist drape settling

atk-b.title: Combo finisher: a golden and silver volley, and an aerial shot (3 frames each)
frames: combo finisher, anticipation: both arms spread wide, two portals open behind him, a gold sword in one and a silver axe in the other, the front foot stepping in
combo finisher, strike: both arms sweep forward and both weapons shoot forward, one just behind the other, a gold streak and a silver streak kept inside this cell, the strongest pose
combo finisher, recovery: arms lowering, the two portals closing, the crimson waist drape flaring, settling back toward stance
aerial attack, anticipation: in mid-air, a portal opening in front of him, low, the hand open toward it
aerial attack, strike: he points down-forward and a gold sword shoots diagonally downward, its trail kept inside this cell
aerial attack, recovery: airborne, body tucked, the hand returning to a ready pose, the portal closing into sparks

atk-c.title: Plunge: gold and silver blades falling, and a Vault volley (3 frames each)
frames: plunge, dive: in mid-air diving straight down, both hands pointing at the ground, two portals above him launching a gold and a silver blade downward ahead of him, gold speed lines and the crimson waist drape flying upward
plunge, impact: landing in a low crouch, the blades embedded point-first in the ground in front, a burst of gold light and dust
plunge, recovery: rising from the impact, the blades dissolving into sparks, back toward stance
heavy attack, charge: right arm raised high, open hand, an arc of seven to nine gold portal rings opening behind and above him, sword, spear and axe points glinting in them, body coiled
heavy attack, strike: he sweeps the arm forward and a staggered volley of seven to nine mixed gold and silver weapons streaks forward across the cell, every weapon kept inside this cell
heavy attack, follow-through: the arm extended, the portals closing one by one in sparks, golden light dissipating

ko.title: Defeat and intro
frames: defeat 1: staggering from the final blow, hands empty, chin still raised
defeat 2: dropping to one knee, the portal behind him cracking, hands empty
defeat 3: collapsing forward, the crimson waist drape falling with him, hands empty
defeat 4: lying motionless on the ground, a few gold sparks fading around him
intro 1: walking in with arms folded, chin high
intro 2: a golden portal opens beside him and a gold sword rises halfway out of it
intro 3: he flicks his fingers and three portals flare open behind him in a crown-like arc
intro 4: settling into the stance, hand on hip, one portal hovering behind the shoulder

sheetNotes.idle: HANDS ALWAYS EMPTY. He holds no weapon at any time; the PORTAL is his only weapon, and no ranged weapon of any kind is ever held. In the combat loop the small gold portal ring hovers just behind his RIGHT shoulder in all four frames, with a gold sword hilt inside it, its glow pulsing slightly; the LEFT hand rests on his hip and the RIGHT hand hangs relaxed and half-open. Chin lifted in every loop frame. The crimson waist drape sways with the breath; the swept-up hair stays crisp. Frame 5 is the guard with a gold shield's face half emerging from a portal in front of him; frame 6 is the low crouch with the shoulder portal still behind him; frame 7 is the skid with the drape swinging forward; frame 8 is the landing with one hand low.
sheetNotes.run: Hands always empty and swinging with the stride; the portal is the weapon, never a weapon in the hand. A small gold portal ring trails just behind his shoulder through the cycle. A regal, unhurried stride, chin high, the crimson waist drape streaming back as he moves.
sheetNotes.air: Hands always empty; the portal is his only weapon and no ranged weapon is ever held. Frame 1 is the crouched take-off, frame 2 the rising jump with legs tucked, frame 3 the apex, frame 4 the falling pose, frame 5 the fast fall diving straight down. In the rising, apex, falling and fast-fall frames the crimson waist drape flares and gold sparks trail behind him. Frame 6 is the wall slide with the back and the LEFT shoulder against a wall on the left, one hand bracing and one foot scraping. Frame 7 is the ledge hang and frame 8 the ledge climb, both with empty hands.
sheetNotes.dash: Hands always empty, the crimson waist drape whipping with each move. Dodge roll 1 to 4: he drops low into a forward roll, tucks into a tight ball with the drape wrapping around him, rolls over the shoulder, and comes out into a low crouch, ready. Ground dash 5: a fast low burst forward, body almost horizontal, faint gold speed lines behind. Air dash 6: body stretched forward through the air, the drape snapping behind him, gold sparks trailing. Heal 7 and 8 keep the standard frames: he pulls a small glass flask of glowing red potion from his belt and drinks it, head tipped back, with a soft red glow (the flask is not a weapon).
sheetNotes.hurt: Hands always empty in every frame; no weapon is ever held and no ranged weapon exists in this character's kit. Light hit and heavy hit show the flinch and the bend backward. Frame 4 is the launched pose flying backward with the drape streaming. Frame 5 is the fall onto his back. Frame 6 is lying flat on his back, hands empty, the drape spread out. Frame 7 is getting up onto one knee. Frame 8 is the return to the proud stance with the hand on the hip and the shoulder portal reappearing behind him.
sheetNotes.atk-a: Hands always empty; the portal is the weapon. Combo strike 1 opens a small gold portal behind the shoulder and fires a gold sword point-first in a straight molten-gold streak. Combo strike 2 opens a portal above the head and a finger snap fires a silver spear forward and slightly down, a silver-gold streak. Frames 1 and 4 are anticipation with the portal opening, frames 2 and 5 are the strikes with the streaks kept inside the cell, frames 3 and 6 are recovery with the portal closing into sparks and the hand returning to the hip with the chin lifted.
sheetNotes.atk-b: Hands always empty; the portals are the weapons. Frames 1 to 3 are the combo finisher: both arms spread wide with two portals behind him (a gold sword and a silver axe), then both arms sweep forward and both weapons fly one behind the other as the strongest pose, then the arms lower and the portals close. Frames 4 to 6 are the aerial attack: a portal opens low in front of him in mid-air, he points down-forward and a gold sword shoots diagonally downward with its trail kept inside the cell, then he recovers airborne with the body tucked.
sheetNotes.atk-c: Hands always empty; the portals and the blades they launch are the weapons. Frames 1 to 3 are the plunge: a dive straight down with both hands pointing at the ground, two portals above launching a gold and a silver blade ahead of him with speed lines; then a low-crouch impact with the blades embedded point-first in the ground and a burst of gold light and dust; then the rise, the blades dissolving into sparks. Frames 4 to 6 are the heavy attack: the right arm raised high with an arc of seven to nine gold portal rings behind and above him; then the arm sweeps forward and a staggered volley of mixed gold and silver weapons streaks across the cell, every one kept inside the cell; then the portals close one by one in sparks.
sheetNotes.art: Vault of Ages, his Rift Art. Hands empty throughout; the portals and the treasures they release are the weapons, and every portal and every weapon stays inside the cell. Anticipation 1: he raises both arms, a large arc of golden portals opening behind him. Anticipation 2: a wall of portals behind and above him, gold and silver weapon points emerging from them, power at its peak. Execution 3: the treasures burst out of the portals (gold swords, silver swords, spears, axes, halberds) flying to the right. Execution 4: a storm of those weapons streams across the right side of the cell. Recovery 5: the portals dim and close, sparks falling. Recovery 6: back in the stance, one hand on the hip, chin lifted, the crimson waist drape settling.
sheetNotes.skill: Gate Shot, his own special: one LARGE ornate golden portal opens behind him and one COLOSSAL gold greatsword fires straight through it. Hands empty until the blade appears. Anticipation 1: he raises his RIGHT hand, palm out toward the front, light gathering behind him. Anticipation 2: the large portal is fully open behind him, the colossal blade's point emerging from it. Execution 3: he points forward and the colossal blade launches out of the portal. Execution 4: the blade streaks forward at full force with a wide gold trail, kept inside the cell. Recovery 5: the portal fades into gold rings and sparks. Recovery 6: back to the stance, hand on the hip, chin lifted.
sheetNotes.misc: Hands empty except where a treasure is shown. Skill throw 1 to 3: he flicks a gold coin forward from his fingers, arm extended, and the coin bursts into a small shimmer of gold light as it flies. Taunt 4: a tiny golden portal opens at his fingertip and a golden goblet rises out of it. Taunt 5: he catches the goblet and raises it toward the opponent with an arrogant half-smile, chin tilted up. Victory 6 to 8: he spreads both arms wide, a crown of golden portals behind him with gold and silver blades circling it, chin high, the crimson waist drape swept back.
sheetNotes.ko: Defeat 1 to 4: he staggers from the final blow, drops to one knee with the portal behind him cracking, collapses forward, and lies motionless with a few gold sparks fading; hands empty throughout. Intro 5 to 8: he walks in with his arms folded and chin high while a golden portal opens beside him and a gold sword rises halfway out of it; he flicks his fingers and three portals flare open behind him in a crown-like arc; he settles into the stance with a hand on his hip and one portal hovering behind his shoulder.
